_comment: MeshGhost settings for this game. The mod starts meshghost.exe for you and it reads THIS file, not the config.json in the release folder you unzipped -- that one is for the server and for running the client by hand. Edit connect_to to your host's address, and make sure room matches everyone else's.
_comment_no_bridge_here: local_game_bridge is deliberately absent: the mod passes its own bridge port when it starts the client, so there is one owner of that value instead of two settings that can disagree. Adding it here would have no effect.

client.name: player
client._comment_show_console: "show_console" is deliberately NOT listed below, because absent means 'decide for me' and that is the useful behaviour: hidden on Windows, where the mod starts and stops MeshGhost for you, and VISIBLE under Proton/Wine, where that cleanup is unproven -- so the process is something you can see and close yourself if the game doesn't. Adding "show_console": false here would switch that off everywhere, including where it is a safety net. Add it (true or false) only if you want to decide for yourself on every platform.
